title: Synthesis and potential anti-inflammatory response of indole and amide derivatives of ursolic acid in LPS-induced RAW 264.7 cells and systemic inflammation mice model: Insights into iNOS, COX2 and NF-kappaB.
authors: Choudhary, Rupali; Kumar, Puneet; Shukla, Sanket K; Bhagat, Asha; Anal, Jasha Momo H; Kour, Gurleen; Ahmed, Zabeer
one_liner_zh: 该文研究熊果酸衍生物的合成与抗炎活性，分子对接仅涉及小分子与TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB蛋白的相互作用，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合位点预测或动态机理建模，且方法为常规对接与湿实验，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ursolic acid (3-hydroxy-urs-12-ene-28-oic acid, UA) is a pentacyclic triterpene present in numerous plants, fruits and herbs and exhibits various pharmacological effects. However, UA has limited clinical applicability since it is classified as BCS class IV molecule, characterized by low solubility, low oral bioavailability and low permeability. In the present study, UA was isolated from the biomass marc of Lavandula angustifolia and was structurally modified by an induction of indole ring at the C-3 position and amide group at the C-17 position with the aim to enhance its pharmacological potential. This modification resulted in the synthesis of a series of compounds which were investigated for their anti-inflammatory potential both in-vitro and in animal models in comparison to UA. In RAW 264.7 cells, UA and its derivatives were non-cytotoxic up to 10 microM. The derivative UA-1 exhibited a significantly lower IC(50) (2.2 +/- 0.4 microM) for NO inhibition compared to UA (17.5 +/- 2.0 microM). Molecular docking showed strong interactions of UA-1 with TNF-alpha and NF-kappaB. UA-1 significantly reduced LPS-induced pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta) in RAW 264.7 macrophages with the inhibition levels of 74.2 +/- 2.1 % for TNF-alpha, 55.9 +/- 3.7 % for IL-6 and 59.7 +/- 4.2 % for IL-1beta at 5.0 microM, respectively and reactive oxygen species while upregulating anti-inflammatory cytokine, IL-10. It also downregulated iNOS, COX-2, p-NF-kappaB p65, and p-IkappaBalpha at both mRNA and protein levels. In LPS-induced systemic inflammation mice model, UA-1 significantly lowered NO, TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta and serum biochemical parameters, reduced tissue damage, and exhibited improved aqueous solubility and moderate lipophilicity. Overall, UA-1 demonstrated superior anti-inflammatory potential, improved solubility, and better therapeutic potential compared to UA.
abstract_zh: 熊果酸（3-羟基-乌苏-12-烯-28-酸，UA）是一种存在于多种植物、水果和草药中的五环三萜类化合物，具有多种药理作用。然而，由于UA被归类为BCS IV类分子，具有低溶解度、低口服生物利用度和低渗透性，其临床应用受到限制。在本研究中，UA从狭叶薰衣草（Lavandula angustifolia）的生物质残渣中分离，并通过在C-3位引入吲哚环和在C-17位引入酰胺基团进行结构修饰，旨在增强其药理潜力。这一修饰导致合成了一系列化合物，并在体外和动物模型中与UA相比，研究了它们的抗炎潜力。在RAW 264.7细胞中，UA及其衍生物在高达10微摩尔浓度下无细胞毒性。衍生物UA-1对NO抑制的IC(50)（2.2 ± 0.4微摩尔）显著低于UA（17.5 ± 2.0微摩尔）。分子对接显示UA-1与TNF-α和NF-κB有强烈相互作用。UA-1在5.0微摩尔浓度下显著降低了LPS诱导的RAW 264.7巨噬细胞中的促炎细胞因子（TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β），抑制水平分别为TNF-α 74.2 ± 2.1%、IL-6 55.9 ± 3.7%和IL-1β 59.7 ± 4.2%，并降低了活性氧，同时上调了抗炎细胞因子IL-10。它还在mRNA和蛋白质水平上下调了iNOS、COX-2、p-NF-κB p65和p-IκBα。在LPS诱导的全身炎症小鼠模型中，UA-1显著降低了NO、TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β和血清生化参数，减少了组织损伤，并表现出改善的水溶性和适度的亲脂性。总体而言，与UA相比，UA-1显示出更优的抗炎潜力、改善的溶解性和更好的治疗潜力。
